test: Optimizer recommendations (12 districts, default settings, GNN fit term off) under three delta forms, with and without a synthetic baseline residual (log-normal, sd 0.2) on observed floor-area components and homes. Jaccard = overlap of the recommended parcel sets (1 = identical).
note: Clip events: quantities floored at zero, which happen when a modelled old-use composition exceeds what was observed (the difference form cannot represent complete conversions without flooring).
